constraints: path, modDate, and modTime must all be the same kind (either all scalar Text/Date/Time, or all arrays: Text array/Date array/Integer array); the two syntaxes cannot be mixed.
In the array-based syntax, modTime is an Integer array (not a Time array), per the documented example (ARRAY LONGINT for arrTimes).

overloadMerges.note: modDate and modTime are filled in by the command (parameter table marks them with the '←' return arrow), so their direction should be 'out', not the syntax-position default of 'in'.

params.name: path
params.description: Text or Text array containing one or more method path(s)
If passed, applies to the host database's methods when called from a component (otherwise ignored).
